change: No changes. Primary (Lats/Latissimus Dorsi + mid back/Rhomboids+Upper Traps+Lower Traps) and secondary (Posterior Deltoid, Biceps Brachii, Wrist Flexors, Rotator Cuff) confirmed correct by EMG research for overhand-grip machine row. Machine reduces rotator cuff demand but Rotator Cuff is still a valid stabilizer secondary.

Added forearms/Wrist Flexors to secondary. The original data omitted forearm activation present in all gripping row movements, confirmed by multiple sources. Also promoted Upper Traps and Lower Traps from secondary (missing in original) into primary mid back entry — original already had Rhomboids+Upper Traps+Lower Traps in primary mid back, so no change there. Rotator Cuff added to secondary (was missing in original data, present as stabilizer on all pulling exercises).

No changes. Stretch targets pectoralis major (chest: Clavicular Head + Sternal Head) and anterior deltoid (shoulders: Anterior Deltoids) as primary stretched muscles, with biceps (Biceps Brachii) as secondary stretch — confirmed by Nelson & Kokkonen Stretching Anatomy and exercise databases. Category Bodyweight, equipment bodyweight, trackingMode timed all correct for a static stretch.

Promoted Triceps Brachii from secondary to co-primary. EMG research (Frontiers in Physiology 2022) confirms triceps brachii is a major prime mover in the overhead press alongside the deltoids — not merely a secondary muscle. Anterior Deltoids + Lateral Deltoids remain primary. Chest (Clavicular Head) and Upper Traps remain secondary. Rear delt not added as its activation is minor in seated front barbell press.

Added Lateral Deltoids to the secondary shoulders entry. The overhead-reaching arm in a seated side stretch places the shoulder in abduction, engaging both anterior and lateral deltoid heads as the arm is raised overhead and stretched laterally. Primary obliques + lats confirmed correct by multiple anatomy sources. Quadratus lumborum is the other primary muscle but has no valid bucket/latin mapping in the system — flagged but omitted per rules.
